speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: Many residents expressed concern about their maids borrowing money from unlicensed moneylenders and some have been sent back.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: So, they are asking when these maids apply to come back to Singapore to work, do we issue them work permits or is it on the Ministry of Manpower's (MOM) list that these maids are not allowed to come back?

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: Does it mean that the employers have to report to MOM so that next time, the maids would not be allowed to come back because they are involved in unlicensed moneylending?

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: Definitely, for those cases that Police is aware of, the maids should be stopped from coming back automatically, without needing the employers to prompt MOM.
